runtimeArgs: flutter analyze || exit 1; cd example; PIPE=/tmp/legend_docs_stdin; rm -f "$PIPE"; mkfifo "$PIPE"; (exec 3>"$PIPE"; while :; do sleep 3600; done) & KEEPER=$!; trap 'kill $KEEPER 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$PIPE"' EXIT; flutter run -d web-server --web-port=8321 < "$PIPE"
